jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager with strong expertise & hands-on experience in server and GPU infrastructure procurement to support our global data center operations in the APAC region. You will operate at a high execution speed and be expected to quickly integrate into ongoing projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing end-to-end procurement of server and GPU infrastructure for new data center builds
  • Negotiating directly with OEM/ODM vendors
  • Creating dashboards and report on existing tasks to ensure all tasks are done in a timely manner within the deadline.
  • Managing cost optimization, supply constraints, and vendor escalations
  • Coordinating closely with engineering, logistics, finance, and operations team
  • Maintenance Procurement: supporting global data centers after go-live, ensuring zero-disruption operations through proactive stock planning, coordinating urgent procurement

We expect you to have:

  • At least 5+ years of experience in server / data center hardware procurement
  • Direct experience working with ODM/OEM manufacturers
  • Strong negotiation skills with a history of securing supply commitments and favorable commercial terms in constrained markets
  • Experience operating in fast-paced, high-pressure environments
  • Ability to quickly understand technical infrastructure requirements
  • Working proficiency in English

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Hands-on experience with GPU procurement
  • Experience in hyper-scale / AI infrastructure environments
  • Experience in global procurement operations
  • Familiarity with NetSuite or ERP systems

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Finance
jobs.jd_full:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London/Cardiff/UK Remote | £80,000 - £125,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

Our Payments team⭐

Payments is at the heart of Monzo. It’s how our customers move, receive, spend and manage their money, from cards and bank transfers to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, payment experiences in the app, and the platform infrastructure that underpins the whole bank.

This role sits in our Payments Platform area, working most closely with our Finance Infrastructure squad. The squad sits in Payments, but partners deeply with Finance teams to build the systems, abstractions and capabilities Monzo needs to operate safely, scale efficiently, and expand into new markets. You’ll work on foundational financial infrastructure: the ledgers, data, controls, reporting, reconciliation and platform capabilities that help Monzo understand, account for and manage money across the bank.

This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited by complex, technical infrastructure. The work is often behind the scenes, but it’s business-critical: it helps Monzo scale, launch new products and markets, support Finance, and keep the bank running safely.

You’ll play a key role by...

  • Building the roadmap for Finance Infrastructure within Payments Platform and executing on it.
  • Partnering closely with Engineering, Finance and Payments leaders to understand what Monzo needs from its financial systems today and as we scale.
  • Translating complex finance, accounting, operational and regulatory needs into scalable platform capabilities.
  • Prioritising across competing stakeholder needs, balancing urgent delivery with long-term system health.
  • Helping Monzo build financial infrastructure that can support multiple products, entities, countries, currencies and regulatory environments.
  • Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Product and Operations.

We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re a strong Product Manager with experience owning complex technical, platform, infrastructure or financial systems.
  • You have enough technical depth to partner credibly with engineers and reason about systems, trade-offs, dependencies and long-term architecture.
  • You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, reconciliation, financial data, controls, reporting, internal platforms, abstractions or backend systems.
  • You can work with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Engineering, Product and operational teams.
  • You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards long-term strategy.
  • You’re high-agency, ambitious and excited to stretch yourself in a team with a high bar.
  • You care about customers and business outcomes, even when the work is several layers removed from the end customer experience.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

What’s in it for you

£80,000 - £100,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.

✅ We can sponsor your visa.

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

The application journey has 3 key steps

First stage - Meet with our Collective Product Director
Second stage - Meet with our Engineering and Finance leadership
Third stage - Product full loop

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We’re looking for a Founding Product Manager to help shape the future of Infisical’s platform. As our first Product Manager, you’ll take ownership of our Secrets Management product line, working closely with engineering and the founders to define product strategy, accelerate innovation, and build a product that developers love.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who combines strong engineering judgment with exceptional product taste. You’ll have the opportunity to establish the foundations of our product function, drive meaningful improvements to a platform used by developers and enterprises, and expand your scope across product lines like Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM as we grow.

You’ll work closely with our founders, engineering, sales, and marketing to:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Secrets Management, making informed trade-offs between customer needs, technical complexity, and business impact to help us build and ship the right things quickly.

  • Work directly with customers to understand pain points, identify opportunities, and translate insights into product improvements that drive adoption, retention, and expansion.

  • Define product metrics, establish analytics and tracking infrastructure, and use data to guide product decisions and measure the impact of what you ship.

  • Own product pricing and packaging, helping determine how we monetize the platform and how features are structured across different tiers.

  • Develop a deep understanding of the developer tools and infrastructure landscape, continuously evaluating the user experience and competitive environment to inform product direction.

  • Partner with engineering, sales, and marketing to bring products to market, shape technical messaging, and enable our go-to-market teams to effectively communicate product value.

Requirements

  • Strong technical background, ideally with previous software engineering experience and a deep understanding of developer tools, APIs, infrastructure, and software architecture.

  • Proven experience owning and scaling a product surface in a Product Management capacity, with a track record of delivering measurable product and business impact.

  • Strong product judgment and analytical skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively, make decisions with incomplete information, and translate customer insights and business goals into a clear roadmap.

  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to customers and internal teams.

  • A bias toward action and high ownership, with the ability to operate independently, move quickly, and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.

  • A tech-forward mindset, with a willingness to get hands-on with technical work, experiment with AI tools, and continuously explore new approaches to solving product and engineering problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience owning pricing and packaging for a software product.

  • Experience building or scaling developer tools, infrastructure, or security products.

  • Experience with open-source or open-core products and an understanding of the needs of both individual developers and enterprise customers.

  • Experience with product analytics, data instrumentation, and building dashboards to measure product performance.

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions | UK | Remote
jobs.jd_full:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud, for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC), which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
  • Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
  • Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
  • Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments

We’re excited about you because you have

  • 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership
  • Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools
  • Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships
  • Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.
  • Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offerings such as AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, or GCP Sovereign Cloud
  • Experience with pricing and packaging across deployment models
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, or other data-intensive infrastructure products
  • Experience working with resellers, systems integrators, or cloud marketplace partners
  • Familiarity with open source software or commercial open source companies

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is GBP 117,949- GBP 141,539. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

Why Mozilla

Mozilla Corporation is a non-profit-backed technology company that has helped shape the internet for the better over the past 25 years. We’re the makers of Firefox, the privacy-focused web browser used by more than 225 million people around the world each month. As we look to the future, we’re working to shape the next 25 years of the internet—one that’s built for people, not just for profit.

Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the 501(c) non-profit Mozilla Foundation, meaning we’re accountable not to shareholders, but to our mission. Alongside thousands of contributors and collaborators around the world, Mozillians design, build, and maintain open-source software that empowers people to use the internet on their own terms.

About this team and role

Firefox Enterprise is seeking a Staff Product Manager to own a major part of our 2027 product roadmap as we grow from our first release into a multi-product enterprise offering. This is a high-impact role for someone who has taken enterprise security products from zero to one. You will set direction, align engineering, design and go-to-market partners, and deliver.

This role is ideal for someone who can work across teams with empathy, build trust with a wide range of partners, and move work forward in a practical, low-ego way. You will join a small product team, and work closely with engineering, security, legal, sales and customers, including our first enterprise pilots. You do not need to know browsers inside out, but you do need to bring structure to ambiguity, make clear product decisions, and follow through.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap and delivery of a major Firefox Enterprise workstream in 2027, starting with our hosted offering alongside the existing on-premise solution
  • Define requirements, success metrics and release plans, and work with engineering, design, security and infrastructure teams to ship them
  • Work with pilot customers and prospects, including IT, security and compliance teams, to understand their deployment needs and turn them into prioritized product decisions
  • Partner with sales, legal, finance and support on packaging, pricing inputs, go-to-market readiness and compliance
  • Contribute to a single cross-workstream roadmap, keeping dependencies, timelines and trade-offs visible to leadership and stakeholders
  • Take on new scope as the portfolio grows, including Thunderbird Enterprise and AI-related enterprise capabilities, and help mentor teammates and establish product practices
  • Champion Mozilla’s values in every interaction.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including taking 0-to-1 enterprise security or infrastructure products (such as identity, endpoint or infrastructure security) from definition through launch
  • Experience owning a hosted or SaaS security product, including data residency and operational requirements
  • Experience dealing with public sector organizations, with a working understanding of sovereignty requirements
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate nuanced topics to different audiences
  • A strong track record of execution and follow-through; you are someone who helps teams turn ideas into action
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and experience setting direction for new products or markets
  • Experience working with engineering, design, security, legal and go-to-market teams to deliver cross-functional programs with strong outcomes
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers, such as IT and security teams, and turning their needs into prioritized product decisions
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • You are motivated by privacy, open source, and building technology that serves the public interest and Mozilla’s mission

Nice to Have

  • Experience working on enterprise browsers, or on adjacent products such as endpoint detection (EDR), identity (IdP, SSO) or device management (MDM)
  • Compliance experience, such as working with legal on data processing agreements and an understanding of NIS2, DORA and GDPR, with the ability to account for Mozilla’s own compliance constraints while enabling the product to unlock compliance value for customers
  • Exposure to AI features in enterprise products, including data loss prevention
  • Experience supporting new market entry or new product releases
  • Experience working with government entities or in government facing businesses
  • French or German language proficiency

What You’ll Get

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. We’re Blue River, a team of innovators driven to create intelligent machinery that solves monumental problems for our customers. We empower our customers – farmers, construction crews, and foresters - to implement safer and more sustainable solutions, driving increased profitability with less reliance on scarce labor. We believe that focusing on the small stuff, pixel-by-pixel and task-by-task, leads to big gains.

Blue River Technology works within John Deere’s vision to “innovate on behalf of humanity” by quickly identifying and solving high-value, high-uncertainty challenges in the fields of AI, machine learning, computer vision, and robotics. BRT acts as a research and development flywheel, building not only new products but new platforms that reliably create value for both Deere and its customers. From fully autonomous machines to highly precise farming equipment, BRT & Deere are partnering to create technical breakthroughs across industries like agriculture, construction, and commercial mowing.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. Through cross-disciplinary collaboration, this mission-driven team is eager to define the new frontier of robotics. We ask hard questions, iterate quickly, and get our boots in the field to figure it out. We won’t give up until we’ve made a tangible and positive impact on the planet!

Blue River Technology is based in Santa Clara, CA.

Summary

Autonomous machines are revolutionizing large-scale agriculture. At John Deere, we’re not starting from scratch; we’re building on proven leadership to scale autonomous machines globally. We are seeking an experienced product manager to define what great autonomous products look like, partner closely with engineering leaders, and work with commercial teams to accelerate growth. To succeed in this role, you’ll need to love making sense out of ambiguous problems, thrive when charting a new course, and possess the cultural athleticism to work effectively in both the worlds of hard iron and Silicon Valley. If you’re excited about building enormous robots that help feed and clothe the world, this role is for you.

  • Employment Type: Full-Time
  • Work Location: Remote in the United States
  • Visa sponsorship: Not available for this position.

Job Responsibilities

A combination, not necessarily all-inclusive, of the following:

  • Build deep customer, business, and market understanding through field research, product/customer feedback, usage data, and quantitative analysis.
  • Identify customer needs, friction points, and adoption barriers and craft concepts that shape product direction.
  • Drive rapid customer-facing experimentation to validate/invalidate early concepts.
  • Translate customer evidence, system performance, and business needs into clear roadmap priorities for cross-functional teams.
  • Define core requirements for operational design domain, data collection, safeguarding, guidance and navigation, machine controls, and precision technology.
  • Set system performance criteria that align product behavior with customer expectations throughout the adoption curve.
  • Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to define and deliver full-stack hardware, digital/embedded software, CVML, and mobile solutions to production.
  • Track usage, mission quality, customer confidence, and satisfaction to improve repeat use and product impact.
  • Whatever it takes to make this product successful.

Required Experience and Skills

  • 8+ years of experience as a product manager in a technology company.
  • Strong technical competency, specifically in robotics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) systems.
  • The ability to collaboratively solve unstructured, ambiguous problems with curiosity.
  • Proven ability to influence, collaborate, and engage with others from diverse backgrounds.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate technical product information clearly, concisely, and creatively.
  • The ability to galvanize a team around a mission and make tough trade-off decisions.
  • Strong background in data-driven analysis and decision-making.
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with software development methodologies (agile, scrum) and modern product management methodologies.

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Experience with or knowledge of the autonomy/robotics space.
  • Entrepreneurial experience taking a product from market entry to scale.
  • MBA or MSE.

Only individual applicants will be considered. We do not work with unsolicited third-party agencies or proxy interview services.

At Blue River, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected pay range is between $142,000 – $250,000/year for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus and a competitive benefits package. During the recruitment process, we may identify an alternative role or level that better suits you. If your ideal role at Blue River differs from the advertised position, we will provide an updated pay range as soon as possible during the hiring process.

We’re passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. While we have more work to do to advance diversity and inclusion, we’re investing in our programs, including recruiting, mentorship, career development, and learning & development, to ensure they support our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals. We support each employee in living a full life, enabling a thriving career, and accomplishing a meaningful, challenging mission while collaborating with incredible people. We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align completely with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

jobs.jd_full:
Description

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

The Keet engine team works on the core that makes Keet tick: connecting peers, replicating data, syncing rooms, and keeping calls and file transfers fast and reliable across every kind of network. We’re looking for an organized, curious Junior Project Manager to help keep that work moving.

You’ll work closely with a globally distributed team of senior engineers, help turn priorities into clear plans, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between releases. This is a great role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into technical project or product management in a deeply technical, open-source environment.

Responsibilities

  • Track engine work across sprints and releases, keeping issues, milestones, and roadmaps current

  • Run or support stand-ups, planning sessions, and retrospectives across time zones (mostly async)

  • Coordinate between the engine team, Keet app/UI developers, and QA so dependencies are visible early

  • Write clear status updates, release notes, and meeting summaries

  • Help triage bug reports and user feedback, and route them to the right engineers

  • Spot risks and blockers early and help the team resolve them

  • Keep internal documentation and processes tidy and easy to follow

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 1–2 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or a similar role (internships and open-source involvement count)

  • Excellent written English communication; you can explain technical progress clearly and concisely

  • Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Comfortable working with engineers and learning technical concepts quickly

  • Experience with issue trackers and project tools (e.g. GitHub Issues/Projects, Jira, Linear)

  • Self-starter who thrives in a fully remote, async-first team

Preferred:

  • Basic understanding of networking or distributed systems concepts (P2P, DHTs, NAT traversal, replication)

  • Familiarity with software development lifecycles, Git, and release processes

  • Some exposure to JavaScript/Node.js or experience working alongside a dev team

  • Interest in privacy, decentralization, or open-source software

  • Agile/Scrum knowledge or a certification (PSM, CAPM, etc.)

  • Experience working across many time zones

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.title: Senior Security Technical Program Manager

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

As a Senior Security Technical Program Manager at BeyondTrust, you will use your technical expertise, business acumen and security domain knowledge to manage and streamline critical CISO Office operations and programs. In this role, you will be an advocate for building seamless and metrics-driven operational frameworks. You will be responsible for working collaboratively with CISO Office teams and business stakeholders to identify operational gaps, document requirements and needs, metrics visualization, and execute programs to streamline the way BeyondTrust build and retains customer trust.

What You’ll Do

  • Oversee, plan, and manage security initiatives for all security pillars.
  • Serve as the Security TPM for the security issues management program, running the end-to-end lifecycle on the security issues management Jira board from identification and triage through handoff, validation, closure, and reporting.
  • Triage every new issues against the priority rubric (exploitability, blast radius, data sensitivity, regulatory or audit linkage, and compensating controls), confirm or adjust the Reporter’s initial priority, and set a due date at triage, hand off to Assignee as identified.
  • Own Critical and High issues day to day, including executive notification, direct engagement with the Assignee, unblocking dependencies, and fast-tracking validation. Monitor additional issues through the recurring security issues management review and step in when an escalation trigger fires.
  • Enforce the analysis gate before handoff, approving a ticket as handoff-ready only when root cause, a specific recommended remediation, named impacted systems and teams, and verifiable acceptance criteria are documented.
  • Identify the correct accountable Assignee by role, run a single structured handoff meeting, and drive formal acceptance in Jira within the agreed window.
  • Confirm Assignee remediation plans meet the acceptance criteria without redesigning them, and help surface cross-team dependencies such as budget, tooling, or other teams.
  • Run the recurring cross-functional security issues review, require an updated due date and logged reason for any slippage, and act as decision-maker on priority and acceptance-criteria disputes, escalating unresolved disagreements to the Sponsor.
  • Formally close security issues only after independent Security validation passes, and reopen failed validations to the Assignee with the specific gap noted.
  • Maintain security issues management board hygiene, including identifying duplicate or overlapping tickets, consolidation opportunities, and tickets missing descriptions, due dates, or owners.
  • Lead the Cloud Governance program to convert eligible cloud-scoped remediations into enforceable Kion guardrails.
  • Create detailed project plans to support each initiative while defining and supporting metric visualization for all of BT.
  • Provide a steady stream of ideas and solutions during security initiatives to introduce innovation and improve operational efficiency.
  • Implement relevant metrics to measure security specific program success, including the security issues management program health (open and closed volume by priority tier, overdue tickets, tickets not yet accepted, and due-date slippage).
  • Develop reports to communicate program progress, including the monthly rollup and the quarterly Sponsor program review, to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with other cross-functional teams.
  • Identify cross-team dependencies to incorporate them into the program planning process.
  • Ensure root cause analysis is completed for technical issues and security findings, and shepherd the implementation of solutions through accountable owners.
  • Make necessary recommendations for adjustments to security processes based on performance metrics.
  • Influence strategic decisions about security direction.
  • Participates in building and managing of AI processes to create operational efficiency.
  • Ensure complete compliance according to industry standards by documenting all the processes and adjusting them, when necessary.
  • Manage project escalations and help assemble project teams to tackle critical items, including executing the security issues management program’s defined escalation triggers (non-acceptance, unlogged slippage, and overdue or Critical findings) to the Assignee’s Manager, Trust & Assurance Leadership, or the ELT Sponsor.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in technology, Business Administration, Computer Science, or related field
  • 5-7 years of relevant professional experience in security, project management, or technology
  • Proficient level of understanding security domains
  • Experience in communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences and vice versa.
  • Experience with creative problem solving in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.
  • Experience in Security or Cloud software solutions
